rule_en: Past continuous (was/were + -ing) = an action in progress in the past, often the background. Past simple = a completed action, often the one that interrupts.
rule_bn: অতীতে চলমান/পটভূমির কাজ → past continuous; সম্পন্ন বা মাঝে ঘটে যাওয়া কাজ → past simple।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: While I was reviewing the pull request, the build was failing
items.explain_en: The short interrupting event (the build failing) takes past simple, while the ongoing background action stays in past continuous.

items.prompt_en: I deployed the patch while the team tested the old release
items.explain_en: The background action in progress during the deploy needs past continuous, not past simple.

items.prompt_en: When the alert fired, I debugged the Apex trigger
items.explain_en: An action already in progress when the alert interrupted it takes past continuous.

items.prompt_en: Yesterday morning I was finishing the report when the standup was starting
items.explain_en: The standup is a single completed event that interrupts the work, so it takes past simple.

items.prompt_en: She was writing the test cases when her laptop was freezing
items.explain_en: The sudden interrupting event (the laptop freezing) is a completed action in past simple.

items.prompt_en: I merged the branch while the pipeline ran the tests
items.explain_en: An ongoing process forming the background during the merge needs past continuous.

items.prompt_en: The client called while we deployed the release to production
items.explain_en: The deploy was in progress when the call interrupted it, so it takes past continuous.

items.prompt_en: As I was walking to the office, I was getting the offer call
items.explain_en: The offer call is a single completed event that interrupts the walking, so it takes past simple.

items.prompt_en: I fixed the validation rule while the data loaded
items.explain_en: The data loading is the ongoing background action, so it needs past continuous.

items.prompt_en: When the demo began, the sandbox synced the metadata
items.explain_en: The sandbox was in the middle of syncing when the demo began, so it takes past continuous.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: While the deployment ___, the build pipeline suddenly failed.
items.explain_en: Past continuous (was running) sets the ongoing background; the past simple 'failed' interrupts it.

items.prompt_en: I ___ the bug report when my manager called me.
items.explain_en: An action in progress (was reading) is interrupted by a completed action (called).

items.prompt_en: When the user clicked Save, the page ___ instantly.
items.explain_en: Past simple 'crashed' is the single completed action triggered at the moment of the click.

items.prompt_en: She ___ for a Salesforce job online when the recruiter suddenly emailed her.
items.explain_en: Past continuous (was searching) is the ongoing background action interrupted by the completed 'emailed'.

items.prompt_en: We ___ the new Apex class yesterday and then merged it.
items.explain_en: Two completed actions in sequence ('tested' then 'merged') both take the past simple.

items.prompt_en: While I ___ lunch, my teammate fixed the broken test.
items.explain_en: Past continuous (was having) is the background action interrupted by the completed 'fixed'.

items.prompt_en: The server ___ down at exactly 3 p.m. during the demo.
items.explain_en: A sudden completed event at a precise time takes the past simple 'went'.

items.prompt_en: They ___ a meeting when the fire alarm rang.
items.explain_en: The ongoing meeting (were having) is interrupted by the completed action 'rang'.

items.prompt_en: I ___ my laptop when the power went out.
items.explain_en: Past continuous (was using) describes the action in progress that the outage interrupted.

items.prompt_en: Last night he ___ the documentation and then went to bed.
items.explain_en: A completed action followed by another ('then went') uses the past simple 'finished'.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I was deploying the change set when the org suddenly crashed .
items.explain_en: Past continuous (was deploying) is the background action in progress; past simple (crashed) is the completed interruption.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: While she was reviewing my pull request , I fixed another bug .
items.explain_en: 'While' marks the longer ongoing action (was reviewing); the short completed action takes past simple (fixed).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: The tests were running while we discussed the new feature .
items.explain_en: Past continuous (were running) sets the ongoing background; past simple (discussed) is the action that happened during it.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: He was writing the Apex trigger when his laptop died .
items.explain_en: The in-progress action uses was writing; the sudden completed event interrupting it uses past simple (died).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: When the recruiter called , I was cooking dinner .
items.explain_en: The short event (called) is past simple; the longer background activity already in progress is past continuous (was cooking).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: We were debugging the flow when the demo started .
items.explain_en: Past continuous (were debugging) is the ongoing action; past simple (started) is the completed point that interrupts it.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: She solved the issue while the build was compiling .
items.explain_en: The completed action takes past simple (solved); the parallel ongoing process takes past continuous (was compiling).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I was studying for the certification when the power went out .
items.explain_en: Was studying is the ongoing background; the sudden completed interruption uses past simple (went out).

items.prompt_en: Say a sentence about what you were doing yesterday evening when something suddenly interrupted you. Use past continuous for the background action and past simple for the interruption.
items.model_en: I was testing the integration yesterday evening when my manager messaged me about an urgent ticket.

items.prompt_en: Say a sentence describing two past actions: one that was in progress and one short action that happened during it. Use 'while' with the past continuous.
items.model_en: While I was preparing for the interview, the recruiter sent me the final schedule.
